verdict.rationale: Lorikeet documents a knowledge-base audit that finds gaps, outdated articles and quality issues (via MCP and release notes). Its simulations replay historical tickets to show knowledge gaps. Coach reviews every ticket and turns findings into fixes, which ties gaps back to conversations the agent fumbled. Missing for 10: explicit detection of conflicting or contradictory content across articles, detail on how gaps are surfaced in the product UI, and independent or hands-on corroboration beyond vendor claims.
